'Julia' (one bare occurrence) resolves to Julia Wieliczko (id 3) since Julia Bojaruniec never appears. Two fictional joke names were dropped: 'Ewa Tylman' and 'Ewa Przódman' at [32:40]/[32:43], invented as examples of made-up-sounding surnames in a joke about people doubting Ola Łomsza's name is real -- not actual mentions of any Ewa entity. One case was excluded rather than guessed: 'Paweł DSM' at [32:21], which doesn't match any of the three candidate Paweł entities (Fomiczewski/Kostowski/Pączek) and appears to be an unlisted streamer. 'Krzychu' at [37:57] (part of a comedic 'everyone lying in bed' bit alongside 'Zagulska leży w łóżku') was read as a self-referential nickname for Krzysztof Gonciarz rather than the separate entity 'prawdziwy Krzychu' (id 108), given the bit's structure. Three residual Rule C warnings from validate_mentions.py are expected and intentionally left unmarked: 'Chris' at [02:56] is a substring of the English idiom 'Jesus Christ', not a reference to Krzysztof Gonciarz's alias 'Chris'; 'Ewa' at [32:40] and [32:43] are the fictional joke surnames 'Ewa Tylman'/'Ewa Przódman' discussed above, not real mentions of any Ewa entity.
